left.raw_text: Patients with stable (Canadian Cardiovascular Society 1, 2, 3 or 4) or unstable (Braunwald class IB, IC, IIB, IIC, IIIB, IIIC) angina pectoris and ischemia, or patients with atypical chest pain or even those who are asymptomatic provided they have documented myocardial ischaemia (e.g. treadmill exercise test, radionuclide scintigraphy, stress echocardiography, Holter tape);
Patients who are eligible for coronary revascularization (angioplasty or CABG);
At least 2 lesions (located in different vessels and in different territories) potentially amenable to stent implantation;
